mineman.config.generic.comment.autoEatPi: Comma-separated list of hotbar slot numbers (1-9) that easyEat can switch to, checked left to right. Example: 7,8,9
mineman.config.generic.comment.protectSt:
Baritone never breaks the blocks in protectedStorageBlocks, anywhere.
During a Smart Mineman store trip it also can't break or place blocks within 5 blocks of a storage point.
Your own allowBreak/allowPlace values come back as soon as the trip ends
mineman.config.generic.comment.protected:
Block IDs Baritone never breaks while protectStoragePoints is on, for mining, building and pathing.
Added to Baritone's blocksToDisallowBreaking; your own entries there stay.
Example: minecraft:chest
mineman.config.generic.comment.storageBl: Blocks a storage point picks up as storage blocks when scanning its area. Edit it with the "Block types" button in the Storage Points screen
mineman.config.generic.comment.autoEatBl: List of item IDs that easyEat will not pick up or eat. Example: minecraft:enchanted_golden_apple
mineman.config.generic.comment.autoEatPi: Which food item to prefer when multiple are available: Most Saturation, Most Hunger, First Found, or Most Items
mineman.config.generic.comment.autoEatTh: How many hunger points must be missing (out of 20) before autoEat and hungryMineman eat. Default: 6
mineman.config.generic.comment.hungryMin:
While a Baritone job or a store trip runs, pauses it to eat once autoEatThreshold hunger points are missing, then continues.
Waits while depositing or looking at a container, so eating can't open it.
With no food it keeps going and tells you once
mineman.config.generic.comment.moveMatch: Ignore item metadata when matching items to move
mineman.config.generic.comment.berndDasB: When enabled, autoEat/easyEat always picks bread first, before applying any other pick order rules
mineman.config.hotkeys.comment.selection: While holding the selection tool (default Flint) in your main hand, sets selection corner 1 to the block you're looking at (up to 1024 blocks). The selection is cleared on a world or dimension change
While holding the selection tool (default Flint) in your main hand, sets selection corner 2 to the block you're looking at (up to 1024 blocks). The selection is cleared on a world or dimension change
mineman.config.generic.comment.muteAllSo: Mutes all game sounds while enabled
mineman.config.generic.comment.itemEsp: Renders a translucent green box around dropped items, visible through blocks
mineman.config.generic.comment.blockEsp: Renders a translucent yellow box around nearby blocks picked in the Block ESP screen, visible through blocks
mineman.config.generic.comment.blockEspR: How far around the player (in blocks) blockEsp scans for matching blocks. Default: 24
mineman.config.generic.comment.entityEsp: Renders a translucent box around every loaded entity whose type is picked in the Entity ESP screen, visible through blocks. Dropped items are never shown here - use itemEsp for those. Each entity type gets its own color
mineman.config.generic.comment.disablePu: Stops the pumpkin blur overlay from rendering while wearing a carved pumpkin on your head
mineman.config.generic.comment.toolSwitc: When left-click is released, undoes what Tweakeroo's tweakToolSwitch and tweakWeaponSwitch did: tools and weapons they pulled into the hotbar go back to their inventory slots and the previously selected slot is selected again. Tools replaced by tweakSwapAlmostBrokenTools are not swapped back in
mineman.config.generic.comment.storageCo:
How storage point contents are read on a server without opening the chests (in singleplayer they are always read directly).
Auto: Servux if the server has it and MiniHUD is installed with entityDataSync on, otherwise the op query if you are op, otherwise only when a chest is opened.
Servux (MiniHUD): needs MiniHUD with entityDataSync on and Servux on the server.
Op query: asks the server for each chest like the vanilla /data command; needs operator rights (permission level 2).
Only when opened: contents only update when you, quick deposit or Smart Mineman open a chest.
The Contents screen shows which one is in use.
mineman.config.generic.comment.toolSwitc: Ticks (20 = 1 second) toolSwitchBack waits after releasing left-click before putting a tool away. Clicking again in that time keeps the tool in hand. Nothing is put back while a block is still being broken. On a laggy server, switching back right away can get the hotbar out of sync with the server (placed blocks flash and vanish); raise this if that happens. 0 = right away. Default: 5
mineman.config.generic.comment.structure: How far (in blocks) the Search button of the Structures screen looks for structures around you, in each dimension. Larger radii take longer. Default: 5000
mineman.config.generic.comment.weaponSwi: Ticks (20 = 1 second) toolSwitchBack waits after releasing left-click before putting a weapon away. Switching items resets the attack cooldown, so this keeps the weapon in hand while you keep hitting. Tools use toolSwitchBackDelay instead. Default: 20
mineman.config.hotkeys.comment.sortInven: Mineman's own inventory sort, while an inventory or chest screen is open (hover your inventory). Puts the items of the active sort profile into their fixed slots and sorts the rest of the main inventory the same way every time. Hotbar slots without a rule and the offhand keep their item. Item Scroller's own sort is not changed
mineman.config.hotkeys.comment.sortProfi: Switches to the next sort profile (set them up in the Sorting screen)
mineman.config.warning.tweakeroo_missing: Tweakeroo is not installed, so this option does nothing.
mineman.config.warning.baritone_missing: Baritone is not installed, so this option does nothing. Install baritone-api-fabric.
mineman.config.warning.baritone_wrong_bu: This Baritone build has no API (standalone jar), so this option does nothing. Install baritone-api-fabric instead.
mineman.gui.warning.itemscroller_missing: (Item Scroller is not installed, so sorting does nothing)
mineman.config.generic.comment.smartMine:
When the inventory gets full during a Baritone mine, build or farm job, walks to the active storage point, puts the items into its storage blocks, and continues the job.
Without an active storage point (or when it's in another dimension) no trip starts; a message says so.
mineman.config.hotkeys.comment.storageSt: Walk to the active storage point now and put the inventory into it
mineman.config.hotkeys.comment.storageGo: Walk to the active storage point's origin
mineman.config.hotkeys.comment.storageSe: Set Baritone's goal to the active storage point's origin
mineman.config.hotkeys.comment.storageCh: Put the inventory into the storage blocks of the nearest storage point, without walking
